meta.what: G = log10(E_Boris/E_scheme), four channels, five configurations, five schemes, Omega h = 0.3
meta.G_definition: log10(E_Boris / E_scheme); positive is better than the Boris scheme; the Boris row is 0 by construction

channel_statistics.trajectory: rms of the position error over the record, r_L
channel_statistics.phase: median of atan2(|v x v_ref|, v.v_ref) over the second half, radians
channel_statistics.energy: median relative energy error over the second half
channel_statistics.spectral: PSD integral of the position error over nu < 0.2 Omega_c^ref, Hann window -- a POWER

meta.spectral_is_a_power: G in the spectral column is a ratio of powers and is therefore twice the corresponding ratio of amplitudes; G/2 is reported beside it.  Ranks are the same under either
meta.channels_are_not_independent: the spectral channel is a band-limited functional of the same position-error series the trajectory channel takes the root mean square of, so the pair (trajectory, spectral) is the one pair with a built-in reason to agree; it is reported with the rest and flagged here
meta.agreement_rule_declared_here: a pair of channels is AGREED in a cell when rho = +1 exactly (identical orderings of the four measured schemes) and DISAGREED when rho <= 0.  The pre-registration fixed no threshold, so this one is fixed here and the whole distribution of rho is written out beside it
meta.why_boris_is_excluded_from_the_ranking: the Boris scheme is the base, so its G is 0 in every channel by construction; including it in the rank comparison would let a constant contributed by the definition count as agreement between two channels
meta.corrector_checkpoint: boris_corrector_b4.pt -- ONE checkpoint; the corrector column is a single run and not an ensemble over seeds (that is W16)
